_comment: Generated from EpsilonRP/PublicAddOns Actions/ConditionsData.lua by `python tools/arcanum.py regen-catalog <checkout>`. Conditions attach to a whole spell (spell.conditions) or to one action (action.conditions), same shape either way: a list of GROUPS, each a list of ROWS of {Type, Input, IsNot}. Execute.lua ANDs within a group and ORs across groups -- disjunctive normal form. No conditions, or an empty list, passes. Input is a comma-delimited string and runs through input substitution before evaluation.

hasAura.name: Has Aura (Self)
hasAura.description: If your character currently has the specified aura active

hasAuraNum.name: Has Number of Aura (Self)
hasAuraNum.description: If your character currently has X number of stacks of the specified aura. May specify 'true' as the 3rd input to change it to a 'Greater Than or Equal To' check (use 'not' on the condition for Less Than).
hasAuraNum.inputExample: <296289, 6, true> - Checks if your character has the 'Rage Stacking' aura applied 6 or more times.

isSpellOnCooldown.name: Is Spell on Cooldown
isSpellOnCooldown.description: If the Spell ID given is currently on Cooldown.
isSpellOnCooldown.inputDesc: To check the Global Cooldown, you can use the dummy GCD spell ID 61304.

hasItem.name: Has Item(s)
hasItem.description: If your character currently has at least one of each item.
hasItem.inputDesc: May supply multiple items, separated by commas.

hasNumItems.name: Has X Number of Items
hasNumItems.description: If your character currently has exactly X number of this item.

hasMoreThanItems.name: Has More than X Items
hasMoreThanItems.description: If your character currently has more than X number of this item.

hasLessThanItems.name: Has Less than X Items
hasLessThanItems.description: If your character currently has less than X number of this item.

hasItemEquipped.name: Has Item Equipped
hasItemEquipped.description: If your character currently has a specific item equipped.

hasSlotEquipped.name: Has Item Equipped in Slot
hasSlotEquipped.description: If your character currently has any item equipped in a specific slot, or if ItemID is given, that specific itemID is equipped in that slot.

isSoundIDPlaying.name: Is Sound Kit ID Playing
isSoundIDPlaying.description: If the given Sound Kit ID is currently playing from an Arcanum Spell / Action / ARC.XAPI. Cannot tell if sounds are playing if played from another source.

isSoundFilePlaying.name: Is Sound File Playing
isSoundFilePlaying.description:
If the given Sound File ID is currently playing from an Arcanum Spell / Action / ARC.XAPI. Cannot tell if sounds are playing if played from another source.

Sounds played by File are considered to be 'playing' forever until explicitly told to stop. If you need better control / knowledge if a sound is actually still playing, you need to either use a SoundKit based Play Sound, or manually 'stop' it after the proper time via revert or separate action.

isMusicPlaying.name: Is Music File Playing
isMusicPlaying.description:
If the given Music File ID is currently playing from an Arcanum Spell / Action / ARC.XAPI. Cannot tell if sounds are playing if played from another source.

Sounds played by File are considered to be 'playing' forever until explicitly told to stop, including music. If you need better control / knowledge if a sound is actually still playing, you need to either use a SoundKit based Play Sound, or manually 'stop' it after the proper time via revert or separate action.

isDead.name: Is Dead
isDead.description: Continues only if the specified unit is currently dead.
isDead.inputDesc: Defaults to player if no input is given.

isFlying.name: Is Flying
isFlying.description: Continues only if the specified unit is currently flying. This includes flying mounts, spell effects, and `.cheat fly`.
isFlying.inputDesc: Defaults to player if no input is given.

isFalling.name: Is Falling
isFalling.description: Returns true if the specified unit is currently falling.
isFalling.inputDesc: Defaults to player if no input is given.

isSwimming.name: Is Swimming
isSwimming.description: Returns true if the character is currently swimming. This only applies if you are in water & in the swimming animation.
isSwimming.inputDesc: Defaults to player if no input is given.

isSubmerged.name: Is Submerged
isSubmerged.description: Returns true if the character is currently underwater. This applies any time you are in water, even if running at the bottom of a surface of water, unless the water is too shallow to swim in.
isSubmerged.inputDesc: Defaults to player if no input is given.

isRace.name: Is Race
isRace.description: If the specified unit is the specified race.
isRace.inputDesc: Defaults to player if only 'race' is given. Race can be given as name or ID.

isClass.name: Is Class
isClass.description: If the specified unit is the specified class.
isClass.inputDesc: Defaults to player if only 'class' is given. Class can be given as name or ID.

isGender.name: Is Gender
isGender.description: If the specified unit is the specified sex/gender. Sex can be given as a word or ID.
isGender.inputDesc: Defaults to player if only 'sex' is given.

hasTarget.name: Has Target
hasTarget.description: Returns true if you currently have anything targeted.

isIndoors.name: Is Indoors
isIndoors.description: Returns true if the player character is currently indoors.

isOutdoors.name: Is Outdoors
isOutdoors.description: Returns true if the player character is currently outdoors.

isMounted.name: Is Mounted
isMounted.description: Returns true if the player character is mounted.

isStealth.name: Is Stealthed
isStealth.description: Returns true if the player character is currently stealthed.

isInInstance.name: Is In Instance
isInInstance.description: Returns true the if player character is inside an instance (battleground, arena, dungeon, raid, etc).

isInParty.name: Is in Party (Self)
isInParty.description: Returns true if the player character is in a party.

isInRaid.name: Is in Raid (Self)
isInRaid.description: Returns true if the player character is part of a raid. You can stack this as 'not' on top of a 'Is In Party (Self)' to check if in a party, but not a raid.

facStanding.name: Has Standing with Faction
facStanding.description: Returns true if the player has a standing equal to (or 'greater than / equal to' if enabled) with the specified faction.
facStanding.inputDesc:
Faction Standing IDs range from 0 (Unknown) to 4 (Neutral) to 8 (Exalted).
When using '.look faction', use the ID in the actual faction name.
facStanding.inputExample: <1228, 5, true> - Checks if your current standing with faction 1228 (Forest Hozen) is rank 5 (Friendly), or higher.

tarHasTar.name: Has Target
tarHasTar.description: Returns true if your target currently has anything targeted. Target-ception.

tarInParty.name: Target is in my Party
tarInParty.description: Returns true if the target is in your party. Cannot check if a target is just in any party.

tarNameIs.name: Target Name Equals...
tarNameIs.description: Returns true if the specified unit's current target is equal to the specified string. Case sensitive.

tarPosRange.name: Target in X Range
tarPosRange.description: Checks if your target is within the number of meters from you. Limited to only working outdoors & not in an instance (dungeon/raid/bg/arena). Only checks XY distance on a 2D plane, does not consider Z / height.

tarInterRange.name: Target in Interact Range
tarInterRange.description: Checks if your target is within the given interaction range. Factors in height.
tarInterRange.inputDesc: Available Interaction Index IDs: 1 = 28 yards, 2 = 8 yards, 3 = 7 yards.

tarAura.name: Target has Aura
tarAura.description: If the target has a specific aura applied.

tarAuraNum.name: Target has Number of Aura
tarAuraNum.description: If the target currently has X number of stacks of the specified aura.
tarAuraNum.inputDesc: May specify 'true' as the 3rd input to change it to a 'Greater Than or Equal To' check (use 'not' on the condition for Less Than).
tarAuraNum.inputExample: <296289, 6, true> - Checks if the target has the 'Rage Stacking' aura applied 6 or more times.

tarIsFriend.name: Target is Friend
tarIsFriend.description: Returns true if the target is friendly to the player.

tarIsEnemy.name: Target is Enemy
tarIsEnemy.description: Returns true if the target is hostile to the player.

tarIsPlayer.name: Target is Player
tarIsPlayer.description: Returns true if the target is a real player character.

tarType.name: Target is NPC Type
tarType.description: Returns true if the target's type (humanoid, beast, undead, etc) matches the type specified.

tarFamily.name: Target is NPC Family
tarFamily.description: Returns true if the target's family (Fox, Crab, Bear, etc) matches the family specified. Does not work on all creatures, but works on almost all beasts. Will return false for anything it doesn't work on.

tarDisplay.name: Target has Display ID
tarDisplay.description: Checks if your target has the given Display ID. Note that this relies on the Epsilon AddOn, and that Display ID sync is not instant and may have a very small delay from when you target the NPC until that data is available.

zoneName.name: Zone Name
zoneName.description: Returns true if the name of the zone you are currently in is the same as the name provided.

subZoneName.name: Subzone Name
subZoneName.description: Returns true if the name of the sub-zone you are currently in is the same as the name provided.

mmZoneName.name: Minimap Zone Name
mmZoneName.description: Returns true if the name of the zone name shown on your mini-map you are currently in is the same as the name provided. Zone name on Mini-Map is dynamic between Zone, Sub-Zone, and WMO Areas.

mapID.name: Map ID
mapID.description: Returns true if the map you are currently on is the same ID as the ID provided.

inRangeXYZ.name: Within Range of Coordinates
inRangeXYZ.description: Checks if you are within the given range (distance / radius) of specific X Y Z coordinates on the given map ID.
inRangeXYZ.inputDesc:
Range is calculated as radial distance from the point. Z Coord (Height) is optional; if given, height is included in distance check, if not, distance is calculated on a 2D plane excluding height.
Map ID is required and will fail range checks if you are on a different map; You may set Map ID as 0 however to skip map ID checks and only look at XY(Z) Range.
inRangeXYZ.inputExample: <2932, 6175.5, 123.5, 1737, 15> - Checks if player is within 15 yards of the given coordinates in Dranosh Valley (which in this case, is the '.tele start' portal).

arcLocations.name: Arc Location Exists
arcLocations.description: Checks if an Arc Location already exists, by name.
arcLocations.inputDesc: The name of the Arc Location 'Key', created by the ARC.LOCATIONS API or a 'Save Location (ARC)' action.
arcLocations.inputExample: <169_Tavern> - Checks if the ArcLocation named <169_Tavern> exists.

phIsMember.name: Is Member
phIsMember.description: If your character is a member of the phase.

phIsOfficer.name: Is Officer
phIsOfficer.description: If your character is an officer of the phase.

phIsOwner.name: Is Owner
phIsOwner.description: If your character is the owner of the phase.

phDMOn.name: DM Mode Enabled
phDMOn.description: If phase DM mode is currently enabled.

phIDIs.name: Is in Phase ID
phIDIs.description: If you are in a specific phase number / ID.

phTime.name: Current Time (Phase)
phTime.description: If the Phase Time is a certain time. Can provide a second input to check if within X minutes of that time.
phTime.inputDesc: If modifier input is a number, checks if you are within that many minutes of the given time, otherwise checks if it's exactly that time.
phTime.inputExample: <13:30, 30> - Check's if it's within 30 minutes from 1:30pm - AKA: Check's if it's 1pm-2pm at all.

phTimeAft.name: Current Time is After
phTimeAft.description: If the Phase Time is after (later than) a certain time.

phTimeBef.name: Current Time is Before
phTimeBef.description: If the Phase Time is before (earlier than) a certain time.

UnitPowerBarShown.name: UnitPowerBar Shown
UnitPowerBarShown.description: Returns true if the Arcanum UnitPowerBar is shown, and optionally only if it's with the specific Power Name.

shiftKeyDown.name: Shift Key Pressed
shiftKeyDown.description: Returns true if the Shift Key is currently pressed. No input required.

altKeyDown.name: Alt Key Pressed
altKeyDown.description: Returns true if the Alt Key is currently pressed. No input required.

ctrlKeyDown.name: Control Key Pressed
ctrlKeyDown.description: Returns true if the Control Key is currently pressed. No input required.

genKeyDown.name: Other Key Pressed
genKeyDown.description: Returns true if the user-defined key is currently pressed. Can accept key (i.e., <tab>) or mouse button (i.e., <LeftButton>, <RightButton>) names.

arcSpellExists.name: ArcSpell Exists (ArcID)
arcSpellExists.description: Returns true if an ArcSpell exists. Can use this in a Cast ArcSpell action for example to make sure that spell exists first before attempting to cast it.

arcSpellOnCd.name: ArcSpell is on Cooldown
arcSpellOnCd.description: Returns true if the ArcSpell is on cooldown. Use a 'Not' condition if you want to ensure the spell is .. NOT.. on cooldown.

arcVarIsTrue.name: ArcVar is True
arcVarIsTrue.description: Returns true if the ArcVar tested is true / truthy. Note that any value that's NOT 'false' or 'nil' is considered truthy, so if the ArcVar = 'Tacos', then this would still succeed.

arcVarEquals.name: ArcVar Equals
arcVarEquals.description: Returns true if the ArcVar equals the given string directly.

sparkOnCDCurr.name: Spark on Cooldown (Current)
sparkOnCDCurr.description: Returns true if the current Spark is on cooldown. Best example is paired with 'Not' to hide a Spark when it's on Cooldown.

sparkOnCDName.name: Spark on Cooldown (By Spark CD Name)
sparkOnCDName.description: Returns true if the given Spark, by Cooldown (CD) Name, is on cooldown. Alt+Right-Click a Spark to copy it's CD Name.

cheatFly.name: Cheat Fly Enabled
cheatFly.description: Returns true if Cheat Fly is enabled.

cheatCast.name: Cheat Casttime Enabled
cheatCast.description: Returns true if Cheat Casttime is enabled.

cheatCooldown.name: Cheat Cooldown Enabled
cheatCooldown.description: Returns true if Cheat Cooldown is enabled.

cheatDuration.name: Cheat Duration Enabled
cheatDuration.description: Returns true if Cheat Duration is enabled.

cheatGod.name: Cheat God Enabled
cheatGod.description: Returns true if Cheat God is enabled.

cheatPower.name: Cheat Power Enabled
cheatPower.description: Returns true if Cheat Power is enabled.

cheatSlowcast.name: Cheat Slowcast Enabled
cheatSlowcast.description: Returns true if Cheat Slowcast is enabled.

cheatWaterwalk.name: Cheat Waterwalk Enabled
cheatWaterwalk.description: Returns true if Cheat Waterwalk is enabled.

roll.name: Random Roll
roll.description: Rolls a random number between the given min & max, and returns true only if the required number is Greater Than or Equal to the roll. If only min is given, it is treated as the max from 1 to #max.
roll.inputDesc: Because sometimes life needs to be unpredictable.
roll.inputExample: <15, 1, 20> to only succeed if a 15 or higher is rolled, out of a roll between 1 and 20.
